x: Albert Sampson, now a sergeant, has been away from England for 3½ years and is now with C.M.F. At a Regimental Sports he won the 440, Mile and Three Miles.

Ken Cuff appeared at the Hall recently wearing a kilt, and seemed even bigger than he did on his last visit. Albert Sampson was a competitor at the Club Handicap meeting after three or more years abroad.
On the same evening the 3 Miles Team Race was decided, but owing to unforeseen circumstances, we only had three distance men available, but A.
